title: 船长的底牌 · TradeMind SDR
style: cinematic photorealistic live-action film still, 1700s Caribbean high-seas adventure, shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with anamorphic lenses, shallow depth of field, cold steel-blue ocean light with warm orange fire accents, drifting gunpowder smoke and embers, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, no text, no watermark

characters.CAPTAIN: the merchant captain: Chinese man in his mid-40s, short neatly trimmed black beard with a few grey hairs, weathered tanned face, tired intelligent eyes, worn wine-red wool frock coat with tarnished brass buttons over a cream linen shirt, dark trousers, leather boots
characters.CAPTAIN_HAT: a battered black tricorn captain's hat
characters.BOSS: the pirate boss: huge broad-shouldered man in his 50s, thick dark beard, scar through his left eyebrow, long dark hair tied back, heavy black leather greatcoat, silver rings, a curved cutlass
characters.MATE: the first mate: tall, very thin young Chinese man in his late 20s, clean-shaven, earnest serious face, dark blue sailor's waistcoat over a rolled-up white shirt, red neckerchief
characters.GUNNER: a young scruffy pirate gunner with a faded red bandana and a lit linstock
characters.MERCHANT_SHIP: a weathered three-masted merchant sailing ship with an oak deck, rope rigging and a wooden cabin door below the quarterdeck
characters.PIRATE_SHIP: a pirate galleon with enormous black sails and rows of cannons, tied alongside
characters.BAG: a black roll-top waterproof dry bag

shots.zh: 大特写：弯刀刀尖缓缓抬起船长下巴，刀面反光。
shots.image: extreme close-up, the tip of a curved cutlass slowly lifting the chin of CAPTAIN, the blade catching cold light, smoke drifting behind
shots.motion: the blade slowly lifts the chin upward, slight push-in, smoke drifts

shots.zh: 过肩中近景：海盗头目贴近船长，身后黑帆遮天，甲板碎木硝烟。
shots.image: over-the-shoulder medium close-up from behind BOSS: the back of his head and his broad black-leather shoulder fill the left of frame as he leans in close to CAPTAIN, whose tense face is sharp in focus, enormous black sails filling the sky behind, splintered wood and smoke on the deck
shots.motion: BOSS leans in closer, his head turning slightly as he talks, CAPTAIN stays silent with his jaw clenched and swallows, black sails ripple

line.text: 说。你最值钱的东西，藏哪儿了？
line.emo: 低沉、压迫感十足、带着威胁，压低声音慢慢说

shots.zh: 眼部特写：船长没看脚边金币箱，下意识瞥向船舱。
shots.image: extreme close-up of the eyes of CAPTAIN, sweat and soot, his gaze flicks sideways away from camera
shots.motion: his eyes glance quickly to the side toward the cabin and back

shots.zh: 快切：金币箱被拖过甲板。
shots.image: low angle, a heavy chest overflowing with gold coins dragged across the wet oak deck by pirates' boots
shots.motion: fast drag across frame, coins spill

shots.zh: 快切：货箱被吊索吊走。
shots.image: wooden cargo crates hoisted by ropes and pulleys from the merchant deck toward the pirate ship
shots.motion: crates swing upward fast

shots.zh: 快切：朗姆酒桶被搬空。
shots.image: pirates rolling and carrying rum barrels off the merchant ship, torchlight
shots.motion: barrels carried quickly out of frame

shots.zh: 中近景：头目把船长的帽子戴到自己头上，得意地说：“谢谢招待。”
shots.image: medium close-up of BOSS alone in frame, centred and facing camera, wearing CAPTAIN_HAT he has just taken from the captain, smug half-grin, black sails and smoke behind
shots.motion: he lifts the hat, places it on his own head and speaks with a smug grin

shots.zh: 特写：火把被随手扔下，火药引线燃起，火星飞快爬向船舱。
shots.image: close-up, a burning torch lands on the deck beside a gunpowder fuse leading toward the cabin hatch
shots.motion: the fuse ignites and a bright spark races along it toward the hatch

shots.zh: 全景：大副已跳上救生艇，伸手大喊。
shots.image: wide shot from the lifeboat, MATE standing in a small rowing boat below the ship's side reaching up and shouting, crew scrambling down ropes
shots.motion: MATE reaches up and shouts desperately, the boat rocks

line.emo: 非常惊慌、声嘶力竭地大声喊

shots.zh: 中景：船长冲到栏杆边，突然停住。
shots.image: medium shot, CAPTAIN runs to the ship's rail, smoke swirling
shots.motion: he lurches to a stop against the rail, grips it with both hands and freezes, breathing hard; he is the only person on deck, nobody else enters the frame

shots.zh: 近景：他猛地转身，冲回浓烟翻滚的船舱。
shots.image: close-up of CAPTAIN at the rail, jaw set, the smoking cabin door behind him
shots.motion: he spins around and runs back toward the cabin

shots.zh: 跟拍：穿过倾倒的桌椅冲进船舱。
shots.image: handheld tracking shot following CAPTAIN from behind into a smoke-filled ship's cabin, overturned chairs and table, lantern light
shots.motion: camera follows him fast through the smoke past falling furniture

shots.zh: 特写：撞开柜门、翻开抽屉、在暗格里疯狂摸索。
shots.image: close-up of the hands of CAPTAIN yanking open a cabinet drawer and a hidden wooden compartment
shots.motion: hands tear drawers open and search frantically

shots.zh: 插入：一袋金币滚到脚边，他一脚踢开。
shots.image: low angle insert, a leather pouch of gold coins rolls against a boot
shots.motion: the boot kicks the pouch away, coins scatter

shots.zh: 近景：船长喘着气：“不是这个……在哪儿？！”
shots.image: close-up of CAPTAIN alone in frame, centred and facing camera, in the smoky cabin, panting, sweat and soot on his face, desperate
shots.motion: he mutters desperately while searching

shots.zh: 交叉剪辑：越来越短的引线。
shots.image: extreme close-up of the burning fuse, only a short length left before the powder hatch
shots.motion: sparks race closer

shots.zh: 交叉剪辑：颤抖的手。
shots.image: extreme close-up of trembling hands of CAPTAIN inside a dark hidden compartment
shots.motion: fingers tremble and grope

shots.zh: 交叉剪辑：大副绝望的脸。
shots.image: close-up of MATE in the lifeboat, desperate face looking up at the ship
shots.motion: he looks up, breathing hard

shots.zh: 近景：拽出黑色防水包，死死抱在胸前。
shots.image: close-up, CAPTAIN pulls BAG out of the hidden compartment and clutches it to his chest
shots.motion: he yanks the bag free and hugs it tight

shots.zh: 全景：冲上甲板，一脚踩上断裂的船栏，纵身跳向下方的救生艇。
shots.image: wide shot from slightly below on the burning deck: CAPTAIN, BAG clutched to his chest, has one boot planted on the broken rail and is crouched to spring, body leaning out over the water, the small lifeboat visible on the waves below, smoke and fire behind him
shots.motion: he pushes off the rail and leaps out over the sea toward the lifeboat below; his body arcs forward and drops fast under gravity out of the bottom of the frame, coat flapping, embers swirling; real-time speed, not slow motion, the camera holds

shots.zh: 全景：身后船舱轰然爆炸，火光吞没画面。
shots.image: wide shot, the cabin of the merchant ship explodes into a huge fireball, debris flying, night-blue sea
shots.motion: massive explosion expands and swallows the frame

shots.zh: 安静近景：船长跌进小艇，满脸烟灰，怀里的包抱得死紧（耳鸣）。
shots.image: quiet close-up, CAPTAIN collapsed in the bottom of the lifeboat, face covered in soot, clutching BAG tightly, firelight flickering
shots.motion: almost still, heavy breathing, embers float down

shots.zh: 中近景：大副看着那个包，声音发颤。
shots.image: medium close-up of MATE alone in frame, centred and facing camera, in the lifeboat looking down at the bag just below frame, soot on his face, shaken
shots.motion: he stares at the bag and speaks, voice shaking

line.text: 您差点把命搭上……就为了这个？
line.emo: 声音发颤、难以置信、后怕

shots.zh: 近景：船长没回答，拉开防水包，取出现代笔记本，掀开屏幕。
shots.image: close-up, CAPTAIN unrolls BAG and pulls out LAPTOP, opening the lid in the rocking lifeboat
shots.motion: seated in the lifeboat he slowly lifts the lid of the closed laptop with one hand, the laptop stays whole and rigid in his lap, the screen still dark

shots.zh: 近景：停顿一秒，只听见急促呼吸声，屏幕尚未亮起。
shots.image: close-up of CAPTAIN's soot-covered face looking down at the dark laptop screen, holding his breath
shots.motion: a still beat, only his breathing

shots.zh: 屏幕插入：TradeMind SDR 亮起，客户资料、商机记录、跟进记录一切都在（后期合成界面）。
全片关键表演：船长闭上眼，肩膀松下来，长长吐出一口气：“还好……账号还在。”
shots.image: close-up of CAPTAIN alone in frame, centred and facing camera, lit from below by the cool glow of the laptop screen, eyes half closed, the tension leaving his face
shots.motion: he closes his eyes, his shoulders drop, a long shaky exhale of relief as if he just saved his own future, then speaks softly

line.emo: 如释重负、带着喘息、轻声而哽咽

shots.zh: 中景（背身）：大副指着燃烧的船。
shots.image: medium shot from behind MATE in the lifeboat, his back to camera, arm outstretched pointing at the burning merchant ship on the water ahead, fire lighting his silhouette
shots.motion: he jabs his arm toward the burning ship, shoulders shaking as he shouts, flames flicker on the water

line.emo: 激动、委屈、带着哭腔地大声说

shots.zh: 中近景：船长抹去脸上的灰，看着屏幕，终于笑了（音乐升起）。
shots.image: medium close-up of CAPTAIN alone in frame, centred and facing camera, soot smeared on his face, lit by the glow of the laptop just below frame, beginning to smile
shots.motion: he wipes his face, smiles with renewed confidence and speaks

line.text: TradeMind SDR还在。客户还能找，生意就能重来。
line.emo: 重新找回底气、坚定温暖、带着笑意

shots.zh: 全景：小艇漂过海盗船旁，头目站在高处，正好听见。
shots.image: wide shot, the small lifeboat drifts past the towering pirate galleon, BOSS standing high on the deck wearing CAPTAIN_HAT looking down
shots.motion: the boat drifts slowly, BOSS turns his head to listen

shots.zh: 中景（侧脸，半掩在炮身与硝烟后）：海盗手下转动炮口：“老大，开炮？”
shots.image: medium shot, GUNNER in profile behind a cannon, half of his face hidden by the barrel and drifting smoke, swinging the cannon toward the lifeboat, linstock burning
shots.motion: he heaves the cannon round toward the lifeboat and calls out over his shoulder, smoke drifting across his face

shots.zh: 近景：头目看看满船抢来的金币，又看看抱着电脑还在笑的船长。
shots.image: close-up of BOSS wearing CAPTAIN_HAT, glancing from piles of looted gold to the lifeboat below
shots.motion: his eyes move from the gold to the boat, calculating

shots.zh: 中近景：头目一把按下手下的火把（手伸出画外）：“别开炮！问他——账号怎么开！”
shots.image: medium close-up of BOSS alone in frame, centred and facing camera, wearing CAPTAIN_HAT, one arm reaching down out of frame pressing a burning linstock away, deadly serious
shots.motion: he pushes the linstock down and shouts with dead-serious urgency

line.text: 别开炮！问他——账号怎么开！
line.emo: 急切而严肃、一本正经地大声喊

shots.zh: 音乐急停。船长抬头，与头目对视。
shots.image: close-up of CAPTAIN in the lifeboat looking up, holding the laptop, meeting the gaze of BOSS
shots.motion: he slowly looks up, a held silent stare

shots.zh: 黑底品牌落版：TradeMind SDR · 生意的底气，带得走。远处喊声：“帽子还你！聊聊！”

line.emo: 隔着距离大声吆喝、带点讨好
